title: Tina Guitar XO Strikes an Emotional Chord with New Single âI MISS YOUâ â Out March 21st
text:
T.H.S.A. Records is proud to announce the release of “I MISS YOU”, the heartfelt new single from independent artist Tina Guitar XO. Set to drop on March 21st, this soulful, guitar-driven ballad captures the deep emotions of love, longing, and the bittersweet ache of distance between two hearts.
Inspired by the beauty and challenge of a long-distance relationship, Tina Guitar XO masterfully weaves passionate instrumentation, raw emotion, and intricate guitar riffs into a song that speaks directly to the soul. Through vivid storytelling and powerful melodies, she paints a picture of lovers separated by miles but bound by an unbreakable connection, cherishing past moments together and yearning for the next embrace.
More than just a love song, “I MISS YOU” carries a deeply personal significance for Tina. She has chosen to release it on March 21st, in celebration of her late father’s birthday which is on March 20th, as a tribute to the man who inspired her to pick up the guitar. “I miss my dad very much,” she shares. “His love for music is what fuels my passion, and this song is a reflection of that love.”
Fans of soulful, expressive music and intricate guitar artistry won’t want to miss this release. “I MISS YOU” will be available on all major streaming platforms on March 21, 2025.
For more information, visit Tina Guitar Blackman’s official social media pages.
